def can_arrange_in_circle(n, numbers):
    numbers.sort()
    for i in range(n):
        if abs(numbers[i] - numbers[(i + 1) % n]) != 1:
            return "NO"
    return "YES"

print(can_arrange_in_circle(n, numbers))
